'''Ganner Two''' was [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] designation in [[Second Galactic Civil War]] during [[Battle of Corellia (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Corellia]]. He served there as a part of the informal [[Ganner Squadron]].
